name: Kizumono no Gakuen 2 ~Case of Saint Spica~
original_name: 傷モノの学園2～case of saint spica～
source:
We used to live a boring life, boring class, conversations with friends.... But one day, a big earthquake strikes and destroys everything. We can't go out and have no way to contact with the outside of school building... confined.... We start to look for the way to get out.... But several missing cases happen and all the girls who come back have been raped.... Extraordinary situation drives us mad and.... There is no way out....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090323052906/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1005334]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
我们曾经过着无聊的生活，无聊的课堂，无聊的朋友聊天……但是有一天，一场大地震摧毁了一切。我们无法出去，也没有办法与校舍外面联系……被限制了……我们开始寻找出去的方法……但是发生了几起失踪案，回来的女孩都被强奸了……特殊的情况让我们抓狂……没有出路……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090323052906/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1005334]Eroge Shop[/url]]
